title: Small Business Support Grant – Bondi Beach December 2025: letter of authority
summary: This page provides instructions and sample texts for creating a letter of authority to allow someone else to act on behalf of your business.
what_you_need: A letter created using your business letterhead.
The text from sample text A or sample text B.
Your business details (inserting details where square brackets [ ] appear).
A signature or digital signature for the letter of authority.
Your specific details (inserting details where square brackets [ ] appear).

faqs.q: When do I need to complete a letter of authority?
faqs.a: You need a letter of authority if you want to nominate someone within your business who is not listed as an associate on the ABR to act on your behalf, or if you want your accountant, tax agent, or BAS agent to act on your behalf.

faqs.q: What information should I include in the letter of authority?
faqs.a: The letter of authority must include the necessary details for your business and the person acting on your behalf.

faqs.q: Who can I use sample text B for?
faqs.a: Sample text B is for a qualified accountant, registered tax agent, or registered BAS agent who is acting on behalf of a client who has asked them to register for a grant, scheme, or support program administered by Service NSW.
